narrative_prose: Inside the ozone-scented interior of The First Forge, Silas tightened the calipers over the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea. The rhythmic pinging of the compressor fought against the cold bite of the brass wrench and the metallic tang in the air, creating a sensory battleground. He needed to DEFEND the delicate copper bulkheads from the volatile flux, ATTRACT the raw ambient static, and carefully CONSUME the latent energy before the erratic spikes caused a system overload. Recognizing that Hector's intuitive pulse was the only way to stabilize the matrix and avoid catastrophic failure, he thrust the heavy wrench into Hector's grip.
